title: Sentinel Managed Security Rate Card: Endpoint List Rates, Discounts and Onboarding Fees
content:
Sentinel Managed Security is priced per enrolled endpoint per month, with separate list rates for workstations and servers on each of the six Sentinel tiers. This rate card sets out, for every tier, the list rates, the discount percentages by term, the ClearPath bundle discount and its qualifying rank, and the one-time onboarding fee figures.

## Rate definitions

| Item | Definition |
|---|---|
| Workstation list rate | List monthly fee per enrolled workstation before discounts (USD) |
| Server list rate | List monthly fee per enrolled server before discounts (USD) |
| Term discount | Discount off list rates by term length (percent, set for each term length the tier offers) |
| ClearPath bundle discount | Additional discount off list rates when the client holds an active ClearPath agreement at or above the ClearPath bundle minimum rank (percent) |
| ClearPath bundle minimum rank | Lowest ClearPath tier rank that qualifies for the bundle discount and the onboarding fee waiver (rank 1 to 6) |
| Onboarding fee per endpoint | One-time onboarding fee per contracted endpoint (USD) |
| Onboarding fee minimum | Minimum one-time onboarding fee (USD) |

## Monthly list rates

| Sentinel tier | Workstation list rate (USD per month) | Server list rate (USD per month) |
|---|---|---|
| Sentinel EDR Essentials | 6.75 | 12.50 |
| Sentinel MDR Standard | 11.40 | 24.00 |
| Sentinel MDR Advanced | 15.90 | 31.00 |
| Sentinel MDR Complete | 21.50 | 39.50 |
| Sentinel XDR Premier | 28.75 | 49.00 |
| Sentinel XDR Enterprise | 36.20 | 58.00 |

## Discounts

| Sentinel tier | Term discount by term length | ClearPath bundle discount | ClearPath bundle minimum rank |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sentinel EDR Essentials | 1-month term: 0.0 percent; 12-month term: 0.0 percent | 0.0 percent | 4 |
| Sentinel MDR Standard | 12-month term: 0.0 percent; 36-month term: 6.0 percent | 5.0 percent | 4 |
| Sentinel MDR Advanced | 12-month term: 0.0 percent; 36-month term: 6.0 percent | 5.0 percent | 4 |
| Sentinel MDR Complete | 12-month term: 0.0 percent; 36-month term: 6.0 percent | 7.5 percent | 4 |
| Sentinel XDR Premier | 12-month term: 0.0 percent; 36-month term: 6.0 percent | 7.5 percent | 4 |
| Sentinel XDR Enterprise | 36-month term: 6.0 percent | 10.0 percent | 4 |

The ClearPath bundle minimum rank refers to the rank of the client's ClearPath Managed IT Services tier, counted from the lowest: 1 ClearPath Monitor, 2 ClearPath Essentials, 3 ClearPath Standard, 4 ClearPath Professional, 5 ClearPath Premier, 6 ClearPath Enterprise. A minimum rank of 4 is therefore met by ClearPath Professional, ClearPath Premier and ClearPath Enterprise, and not met by the three lower ClearPath tiers.

## One-time onboarding fee figures

| Sentinel tier | Onboarding fee per contracted endpoint (USD) | Onboarding fee minimum (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Sentinel EDR Essentials | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Sentinel MDR Standard | 8.00 | 750.00 |
| Sentinel MDR Advanced | 10.00 | 1250.00 |
| Sentinel MDR Complete | 12.00 | 1750.00 |
| Sentinel XDR Premier | 15.00 | 2500.00 |
| Sentinel XDR Enterprise | 18.00 | 5000.00 |

## Reading the rate card

- A term discount exists only for the term lengths shown against a tier; Sentinel XDR Enterprise shows the 36-month term alone, and Sentinel EDR Essentials shows the 1-month and 12-month terms.
- On Sentinel EDR Essentials the bundle discount and both onboarding fee figures are zero, so neither the bundle discount nor the onboarding fee changes the amount owed on that tier.
- The highest bundle discount on the card is 10.0 percent, on Sentinel XDR Enterprise; the highest onboarding fee minimum is 5000.00 USD, on the same tier.
